   154→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   155→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Produce a coherent
   156→prioritized strategy for all open review issues.
   157→
   158→Your plan should:
   159→- Cluster issues by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   160→- Give each cluster a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   161→- Order clusters by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   162→- Dismiss issues that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   163→- Mark which clusters are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   164→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   165→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all issues coherently
   166→
   167→Available directions for clusters: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   168→
   169→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   170→- `desloppify plan queue` — view the execution queue in priority order
   171→- `desloppify backlog` — inspect broader open work outside the execution queue
   172→- `desloppify plan focus <name>` — focus the queue on one cluster
   173→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   174→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   175→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   176→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   177→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   178→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   179→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   180→
   181→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Issues not assigned to any cluster
   182→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed issues will be
   183→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   184→
   185→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   186→{
   187→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   188→  "clusters": [
   189→    {
   190→      "name": "slug-name",
   191→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   192→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   193→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   194→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   195→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   196→      "agent_safe": true,
   197→      "dependency_order": 1,
   198→      "action_steps": [
   199→        {
   200→          "title": "Short imperative step title",
   201→          "detail": "Concrete implementation detail with file paths/locations",
   202→          "issue_refs": ["id1"]
   203→        }
   204→      ],
   205→      "status": "pending"
   206→    }
   207→  ],
   208→  "dismissed_issues": [
   209→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   210→  ],
   211→  "contradiction_notes": [
   212→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   213→  ],
   214→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   215→}
   216→"""
   217→
   218→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   219→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   220→    parts: list[str] = []
   221→
   222→    if si.existing_clusters:
   223→        parts.append("## Existing clusters")
   224→        for name, cluster in sorted(si.existing_clusters.items()):
   225→            status = cluster.get("status", "pending")
   226→            thesis = cluster.get("thesis", "")
   227→            direction = cluster.get("direction", "")
   228→            fids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   229→            parts.append(
   230→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   231→                f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   232→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   233→            )
   234→        parts.append("")
   235→
   236→    # Section: what changed
   237→    if si.new_since_last:
   238→        parts.append(f"## New issues since last triage ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   239→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   240→            f = si.open_issues.get(fid, {})
   241→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   242→        parts.append("")
   243→
   244→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   245→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last triage ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   246→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   247→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   248→        parts.append("")
   249→
   250→    if si.resolved_issues:
   251→        parts.append(
   252→            "## Resolved review issues available for recurrence context "
   253→            f"({len(si.resolved_issues)})"
   254→        )
   255→        resolved_ids = sorted(si.resolved_issues)
   256→        for fid in resolved_ids[:30]:
   257→            issue = si.resolved_issues.get(fid, {})
   258→            summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   259→            dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   260→            dim_suffix = f" [{dimension}]" if dimension else ""
   261→            parts.append(f"- {fid}{dim_suffix}: {summary}")
   262→        if len(resolved_ids) > 30:
   263→            parts.append(f"- ... and {len(resolved_ids) - 30} more resolved issues")
   264→        parts.append("")
   265→
   266→    if si.completed_clusters:
   267→        parts.append(
   268→            "## Completed clusters since last triage "
   269→            f"({len(si.completed_clusters)})"
   270→        )
   271→        completed = sorted(
   272→            si.completed_clusters,
   273→            key=lambda cluster: str(cluster.get("completed_at", "")),
   274→            reverse=True,
   275→        )
   276→        for cluster in completed[:10]:
   277→            name = str(cluster.get("name", "(unnamed cluster)"))
   278→            thesis = str(cluster.get("thesis") or cluster.get("description") or "")
   279→            completed_at = str(cluster.get("completed_at", ""))
   280→            issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   281→            issue_count = len(issue_ids) if isinstance(issue_ids, list) else 0
   282→            parts.append(
   283→                f"- {name}: {thesis} (issues: {issue_count}, completed_at: {completed_at})"
   284→            )
   285→        if len(completed) > 10:
   286→            parts.append(f"- ... and {len(completed) - 10} more completed clusters")
   287→        parts.append("")
   288→
   289→    recurring = _recurring_dimensions(si.open_issues, si.resolved_issues)
   290→    if recurring:
   291→        parts.append(
   292→            "## Potential recurring dimensions (resolved issues still have open peers)"
   293→        )
   294→        for dimension, bucket in recurring.items():
   295→            open_count = len(bucket["open"])
   296→            resolved_count = len(bucket["resolved"])
   297→            parts.append(

   299→            )

    51→    issue_data: dict[str, dict] = {}

1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions`` and ``auto_cluster``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.base.config import DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    13→from desloppify.base.enums import Status
    14→from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
    15→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import issue_in_scan_scope
    16→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    17→from desloppify.engine.planning.helpers import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    18→
    19→# Detectors whose issues are NOT objective mechanical work.
    20→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    21→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    22→})
    23→
    24→
    25→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    26→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    27→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    28→
    29→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective issues?
    30→    objective_count: int  # how many
    31→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    32→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    33→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    34→
    35→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    36→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    37→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    38→            return True  # unconditional
    39→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    40→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    41→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    42→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    43→        return False
    44→
    45→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    46→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    47→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    48→            return False  # never evict unscored
    49→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    50→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    51→        return False
    52→
    53→    @property
    54→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    55→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    56→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    57→
    58→
    59→def _is_evidence_only(issue: dict) -> bool:
    60→    """Return True if the issue is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    61→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    62→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    63→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    64→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    65→        issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    66→        if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
    67→            return True
    68→    return False
    69→
    70→
    71→class _ScanPathFromStatePolicy:
    72→    """Sentinel type: resolve scan_path from state."""
    73→
    74→
    75→_SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY = _ScanPathFromStatePolicy()
    76→ScanPathPolicyOption = str | None | _ScanPathFromStatePolicy
    77→
    78→
    79→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    80→    state: StateModel,
    81→    *,
    82→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    83→    scan_path: ScanPathPolicyOption = _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY,
    84→    plan: dict | None = None,
    85→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    86→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    87→
    88→    *scan_path* defaults to ``state["scan_path"]`` so callers don't need to
    89→    thread it manually.  Pass an explicit ``str`` to override, or ``None``
    90→    to disable scope filtering.  When *plan* is set, issues whose IDs
    91→    appear in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    92→
    93→    Imports policy helpers from ``stale_policy`` so this module remains
    94→    side-effect free and cycle-safe.
    95→    """
    96→    from desloppify.engine._plan.policy.stale import (
    97→        current_stale_ids,
    98→        current_under_target_ids,
    99→        current_unscored_ids,
   100→    )
   101→
   102→    resolved_scan_path: str | None = (
   103→        state.get("scan_path")
   104→        if isinstance(scan_path, _ScanPathFromStatePolicy)
   105→        else scan_path
   106→    )
   107→
   108→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   109→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   110→
   111→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective issues.
   112→    # Evidence-only issues (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   113→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   114→    # Issues outside scan_path and plan-skipped issues are also excluded
   115→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   116→    objective_count = sum(
   117→        1
   118→        for issue_id, issue in issues.items()
   119→        if issue.get("status") == Status.OPEN
   120→        and issue.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   121→        and not issue.get("suppressed")
   122→        and not _is_evidence_only(issue)
   123→        and issue_in_scan_scope(str(issue.get("file", "")), resolved_scan_path)
   124→        and issue_id not in skipped_ids
   125→    )
   126→
   127→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   128→    stale = current_stale_ids(state)
   129→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   130→
   131→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   132→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   133→        objective_count=objective_count,
   134→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   135→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   136→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   137→    )
   138→
   139→
   140→__all__ = [
   141→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   142→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   143→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   144→]
   145→

1→"""Pure grouping/description/action strategy for plan auto-clustering."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import os
     6→
     7→from desloppify.base.registry import DetectorMeta
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.constants import AUTO_PREFIX
     9→
    10→
    11→def extract_subtype(issue: dict) -> str | None:
    12→    """Extract the subtype/kind from a issue."""
    13→    detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    14→    kind = detail.get("kind")
    15→    if kind:
    16→        return kind
    17→
    18→    issue_id = issue.get("id", "")
    19→    parts = issue_id.split("::")
    20→    if len(parts) >= 3:
    21→        candidate = parts[-1]
    22→        if "/" not in candidate and "." not in candidate:
    23→            return candidate
    24→    return None
    25→
    26→
    27→def grouping_key(issue: dict, meta: DetectorMeta | None) -> str | None:
    28→    """Compute a deterministic grouping key for a issue."""
    29→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    30→
    31→    if meta is None:
    32→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    33→
    34→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    35→        detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    36→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
    37→        if dimension:
    38→            return f"review::{dimension}"
    39→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    40→
    41→    if meta.needs_judgment and detector in ("structural", "responsibility_cohesion"):
    42→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
    43→        if file_path:
    44→            basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    45→            return f"file::{detector}::{basename}"
    46→
    47→    if meta.needs_judgment:
    48→        subtype = extract_subtype(issue)
    49→        if subtype:
    50→            return f"typed::{detector}::{subtype}"
    51→
    52→    if meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
    53→        return f"auto::{detector}"
    54→
    55→    return f"detector::{detector}"
    56→
    57→
    58→def cluster_name_from_key(key: str) -> str:
    59→    """Convert a grouping key to an ``auto/...`` cluster name."""
    60→    parts = key.split("::")
    61→    if len(parts) == 2:
    62→        prefix_type = parts[0]
    63→        if prefix_type == "review":
    64→            return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}review-{parts[1]}"
    65→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}"
    66→    if len(parts) == 3:
    67→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}"
    68→    return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{key.replace('::', '-')}"
    69→
    70→
    71→def generate_description(
    72→    cluster_name: str,
    73→    members: list[dict],
    74→    meta: DetectorMeta | None,
    75→    subtype: str | None,
    76→) -> str:
    77→    """Generate a human-readable cluster description."""
    78→    _ = cluster_name
    79→    count = len(members)
    80→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
    81→
    82→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    83→        detail = (members[0].get("detail") or {}) if members else {}
    84→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", detector)
    85→        return f"Address {count} {dimension} review issues"
    86→
    87→    if detector == "structural":
    88→        files = {os.path.basename(member.get("file", "")) for member in members}
    89→        if len(files) == 1:
    90→            return f"Review file size: {next(iter(files))}"
    91→        return f"Review {count} large files"
    92→
    93→    display = meta.display if meta else detector
    94→    if subtype:
    95→        label = subtype.replace("_", " ")
    96→        return f"Fix {count} {label} issues"
    97→
    98→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
    99→        return f"Remove {count} {display} issues"
   100→
   101→    return f"Fix {count} {display} issues"
   102→
   103→
   104→def subtype_has_fixer(meta: DetectorMeta, subtype: str | None) -> str | None:
   105→    """Check if a subtype maps to a detector fixer."""
   106→    if not meta.fixers or not subtype:
   107→        return None
   108→    fixer_name = subtype.replace("_", "-")
   109→    if fixer_name in meta.fixers:
   110→        return fixer_name
   111→    for fixer in meta.fixers:
   112→        if subtype in fixer:
   113→            return fixer
   114→    return None
   115→
   116→
   117→def strip_guidance_examples(guidance: str) -> str:
   118→    """Strip subtype examples from guidance text."""
   119→    if " — " in guidance:
   120→        return guidance.split(" — ", 1)[0].strip()
   121→    return guidance
   122→
   123→
   124→_ACTION_TYPE_TEMPLATES: dict[str, str] = {
   125→    "reorganize": "reorganize with desloppify move",
   126→    "refactor": "review and refactor each issue",
   127→    "manual_fix": "review and fix each issue",
   128→}
   129→
   130→
   131→def generate_action(
   132→    meta: DetectorMeta | None,
   133→    subtype: str | None,
   134→) -> str:
   135→    """Generate an action string from detector metadata."""
   136→    if meta is None:
   137→        return "review and fix each issue"
   138→
   139→    if subtype and meta.fixers:
   140→        matched_fixer = subtype_has_fixer(meta, subtype)
   141→        if matched_fixer:
   142→            return f"desloppify autofix {matched_fixer} --dry-run"
   143→    elif meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers and not meta.needs_judgment:
   144→        return f"desloppify autofix {meta.fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   145→
   146→    if meta.tool == "move":

### 3. Review→Concerns Issue Pipeline

**Location:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/intelligence/review/importing/holistic_issue_flow.py:125-140`

When a reviewer flags something as confirmed during `desloppify review`:

```python
is_confirmed_concern = issue.get("concern_verdict") == "confirmed"
detector = "concerns" if is_confirmed_concern else "review"
```

**Determination logic:**
- If `concern_verdict == "confirmed"` → detector = `"concerns"`
- Otherwise → detector = `"review"`

The issue name becomes: `concern::{dimension}::{identifier}` for concerns, or `holistic::{dimension}::{identifier}` for review.

**Answer to Q3:** The detector is determined by the `concern_verdict` field from the review payload:
- `"concerns"` = confirmed verdict
- `"review"` = unconfirmed findings

## Critical Synthesis: Review→Concerns→Triage Path

**Complete flow:**

1. **Review import** (`desloppify review`):
   - Findings with `concern_verdict="confirmed"` → detector = `"concerns"`
   - Issues are stored in state with detector name and dimension metadata

2. **Auto-clustering**:
   - `concerns` issues cluster by dimension (same as `review`)
   - When 2+ `concerns::*` issues share a dimension, they auto-cluster into `auto/review-{dimension}`
   - These auto-clusters appear in the plan

3. **Triage input collection**:
   - Both `"review"` and `"concerns"` detectors are explicitly included in `open_issues`
   - Observe stage receives full set of concerns issues via `si.open_issues`
   - Issues are available for citation and analysis

4. **Triage processing**:
   - LLM sees all review + concerns issues
   - Can group/dismiss/reorganize them
   - Can create new clusters or add to existing ones

**Answer to your verification question:** YES, if you stop auto-clustering `needs_judgment=True` findings, the review→concerns→triage path will **still work properly** because:

1. ✅ `concerns` doesn't have `needs_judgment=True` (already not auto-clustering based on that flag)
2. ✅ `concerns` issues are explicitly collected in `collect_triage_input()` 
3. ✅ Observe stage has full visibility into all concerns issues via `si.open_issues`
4. ✅ Concerns issues will surface as individual items or manually-curated clusters, not via auto-clusters

The triage process will still see them, still let reviewers analyze them, and still let the user organize them into clusters or dismiss them.

   The conversation has two main threads:
   
   **Thread 1 (completed):** Review recent commits and unstaged changes on branch `0.9.5` for quality, identify issues, and fix them. This was done twice as the unstaged changes grew.

The user discovered that mechanical extract-method churn was being driven by desloppify's own auto-cluster system creating "Fix X" tasks that agents blindly comply with. The user wants a long-term solution where judgment-required findings flow through the subjective review process rather than directly becoming execution queue tasks. The current plan: don't auto-cluster `needs_judgment=True` findings — let them remain as scoring data + review evidence, and only create tasks when a reviewer confirms them as real concerns.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Auto-clustering**: `auto_cluster_issues()` groups open findings by detector/subtype into `auto/` clusters that appear in the execution queue
   - **`needs_judgment` flag**: Boolean on `DetectorMeta` — indicates whether a finding requires human evaluation vs. mechanical fix
   - **`_planned_item_ids()`** in `core.py`: Single function that determines execution queue vs. backlog membership
   - **`_group_clusterable_issues()`** in `auto_cluster_sync_issue.py`: Filters which issues get auto-clustered
   - **Mechanical evidence flow**: `gather_mechanical_evidence()` aggregates detector findings into evidence clusters shown to reviewers
   - **Review→Concerns pipeline**: Reviewer confirms finding → `concern_verdict="confirmed"` → `detector="concerns"` (no `needs_judgment`) → auto-clusters normally
   - **Triage data**: `collect_triage_input()` explicitly collects `"review"` and `"concerns"` detector issues into `open_issues`
   - **Wontfix permanence**: `upsert_issues()` only reopens `fixed`/`auto_resolved`/`false_positive`, NOT `wontfix`
   - **`standalone_threshold`**: Confidence floor for standalone queue items — exists but auto-clustering ignores it
   - **Goodhart's Law**: The tool says "reduce cyclomatic complexity" and agents game the metric by extracting functions

     - `_filter_plan_visibility()` uses tracked IDs to split execution vs backlog
     - Earlier plan versions proposed modifying this; current plan doesn't need to change it
     ```python
     def _planned_item_ids(plan: dict) -> set[str]:
         tracked_ids: set[str] = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
         tracked_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
         tracked_ids.update(plan.get("overrides", {}).keys())
         for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
             tracked_ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
             for step in cluster.get("action_steps", []):
                 if isinstance(step, dict):
                     tracked_ids.update(step.get("issue_refs", []))
         subjective_defer_meta = plan.get("subjective_defer_meta", {})
         if isinstance(subjective_defer_meta, dict):
             tracked_ids.update(subjective_defer_meta.get("force_visible_ids", []))
         return tracked_ids
     ```

    25→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    26→class AutoClusterSyncResult:
    27→    """Explicit result describing what `_sync_auto_cluster` changed."""
    28→

    35→def _manual_member_ids(clusters: dict) -> set[str]:
    36→    """Collect all issue IDs belonging to manual (non-auto) clusters."""
    37→    ids: set[str] = set()
    38→    for cluster in clusters.values():
    39→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
    40→            ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
    41→    return ids
    42→
    43→
    44→def _group_clusterable_issues(
    45→    issues: dict,
    46→    *,
    47→    manual_member_ids: set[str],
    48→) -> tuple[dict[str, list[str]], dict[str, dict]]:
    49→    """Group open, non-suppressed, non-manual issues by detector/subtype key."""
    50→    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    51→    issue_data: dict[str, dict] = {}
    52→    for fid, issue in issues.items():
    53→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
    54→            continue
    55→        if issue.get("suppressed"):
    56→            continue
    57→        if fid in manual_member_ids:
    58→            continue
    59→
    60→        detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    61→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    62→        key = _grouping_key(issue, meta)
    63→        if key is None:
    64→            continue
    65→
    66→        groups[key].append(fid)
    67→        issue_data[fid] = issue
    68→
    69→    groups = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE}
    70→    return groups, issue_data
    71→
    72→
    73→def _sync_user_modified_cluster_members(
    74→    plan: dict,
    75→    *,
    76→    clusters: dict,
    77→    existing_name: str,
    78→    member_ids: list[str],
    79→    now: str,
    80→) -> int:
    81→    """Sync member IDs for a user-modified cluster, returns count of changes."""
    82→    cluster = clusters[existing_name]
    83→    changes = 0
    84→    existing_ids = set(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
    85→    new_ids = [fid for fid in member_ids if fid not in existing_ids]
    86→    if new_ids:
    87→        cluster["issue_ids"].extend(new_ids)
    88→        cluster["updated_at"] = now
    89→        changes = 1
    90→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
    91→    for fid in member_ids:
    92→        if fid not in overrides:
    93→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
    94→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = existing_name
    95→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
    96→    return changes
    97→

    99→def _sync_auto_cluster(
   100→    plan: dict,
   101→    clusters: dict,
   102→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   103→    *,
   104→    cluster_key: str,
   105→    cluster_name: str,
   106→    member_ids: list[str],
   107→    description: str,
   108→    action: str,
   109→    now: str,
   110→    optional: bool = False,
   111→) -> AutoClusterSyncResult:
   112→    """Create/update one auto-cluster and report the mutation outcome.
   113→
   114→    Mutates:
   115→      - ``clusters`` (cluster create/update),
   116→      - ``existing_by_key`` (cluster-key to name binding),
   117→      - ``plan['overrides']`` (cluster ownership for each member issue).
   118→    """
   119→    changes = 0
   120→    created = False
   121→    existing_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key)
   122→    if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   123→        cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   124→        old_ids = set(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   125→        new_ids_set = set(member_ids)
   126→        if (
   127→            old_ids != new_ids_set
   128→            or cluster.get("description") != description
   129→            or cluster.get("action") != action
   130→        ):
   131→            cluster["issue_ids"] = list(member_ids)
   132→            cluster["description"] = description
   133→            cluster["action"] = action
   134→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   135→            changes = 1
   136→    else:
   137→        new_cluster = {
   138→            "name": cluster_name,
   139→            "description": description,
   140→            "issue_ids": list(member_ids),
   141→            "created_at": now,
   142→            "updated_at": now,
   143→            "auto": True,
   144→            "cluster_key": cluster_key,
   145→            "action": action,
   146→            "user_modified": False,
   147→        }
   148→        if optional:
   149→            new_cluster["optional"] = True
   150→        clusters[cluster_name] = new_cluster
   151→        existing_by_key[cluster_key] = cluster_name
   152→        changes = 1
   153→        created = True
   154→
   155→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
   156→    current_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key, cluster_name)
   157→    for fid in member_ids:
   158→        if fid not in overrides:
   159→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   160→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = current_name
   161→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   162→
   163→    return AutoClusterSyncResult(
   164→        cluster_name=current_name,
   165→        changed=bool(changes),
   166→        created=created,
   167→        member_count=len(member_ids),
   168→    )
   169→
   170→
   171→def sync_issue_clusters(
   172→    plan: dict,
   173→    issues: dict,
   174→    clusters: dict,
   175→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   176→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
   177→    now: str,
   178→) -> int:
   179→    """Group open issues by detector/subtype and sync auto-clusters."""
   180→    changes = 0
   181→
   182→    groups, issue_data = _group_clusterable_issues(
   183→        issues, manual_member_ids=_manual_member_ids(clusters)
   184→    )
   185→
   186→    for key, member_ids in groups.items():
   187→        active_auto_keys.add(key)
   188→        cluster_name = _cluster_name_from_key(key)
   189→
   190→        rep = issue_data.get(member_ids[0], {})
   191→        detector = rep.get("detector", "")
   192→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   193→        members = [issue_data[fid] for fid in member_ids if fid in issue_data]
   194→
   195→        key_parts = key.split("::")
   196→        subtype = key_parts[2] if len(key_parts) >= 3 else None
   197→
   198→        description = _generate_description(cluster_name, members, meta, subtype)
   199→        action = _generate_action(meta, subtype)
   200→
   201→        existing_name = existing_by_key.get(key)
   202→        if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   203→            cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   204→            if cluster.get("user_modified"):
   205→                changes += _sync_user_modified_cluster_members(
   206→                    plan,
   207→                    clusters=clusters,
   208→                    existing_name=existing_name,
   209→                    member_ids=member_ids,
   210→                    now=now,
   211→                )
   212→                continue
   213→
   214→        if cluster_name in clusters and clusters[cluster_name].get("cluster_key") != key:
   215→            cluster_name = f"{cluster_name}-{len(member_ids)}"
   216→
   217→        sync_result = _sync_auto_cluster(
   218→            plan,
   219→            clusters,
   220→            existing_by_key,
   221→            cluster_key=key,
   222→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   223→            member_ids=member_ids,
   224→            description=description,
   225→            action=action,
   226→            now=now,
   227→        )
   228→        changes += int(sync_result.changed)
   229→
   230→    return changes
   231→
   232→
   233→__all__ = ["AutoClusterSyncResult", "sync_issue_clusters"]

   213→    skipped_subjective_ids = _skipped_subjective_ids(plan)
   214→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   215→
   216→    stale_state_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_state_ids = _subjective_state_sets(
   217→        state, policy=policy, target_strict=target_strict
   218→    )
   219→    unscored_queue_ids, stale_queue_ids, under_target_queue_ids = _queue_subjective_members(
   220→        order,
   221→        stale_state_ids=stale_state_ids,
   222→        under_target_ids=under_target_ids,
   223→        unscored_state_ids=unscored_state_ids,
   224→    )
   225→
   226→    has_objective_items = _has_objective_backlog(issues, policy)
   227→    for spec in _subjective_cluster_specs(
   228→        unscored_queue_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   229→        stale_queue_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   230→        under_target_queue_ids=under_target_queue_ids,
   231→        skipped_subjective_ids=skipped_subjective_ids,
   232→        has_objective_items=has_objective_items,
   233→    ):
   234→        changes += _sync_subjective_cluster(
   235→            plan=plan,
   236→            clusters=clusters,
   237→            existing_by_key=existing_by_key,
   238→            active_auto_keys=active_auto_keys,
   239→            [REDACTED],
   240→            cluster_name=spec.cluster_name,
   241→            member_ids=spec.member_ids,
   242→            description=spec.description,
   243→            action=spec.action,
   244→            now=now,
   245→            optional=spec.optional,
   246→        )
   247→
   248→    return changes
   249→
   250→
   251→__all__ = ["prune_stale_clusters", "sync_issue_clusters", "sync_subjective_clusters"]

    10→
    11→def extract_subtype(issue: dict) -> str | None:
    12→    """Extract the subtype/kind from a issue."""
    13→    detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    14→    kind = detail.get("kind")
    15→    if kind:
    16→        return kind
    17→
    18→    issue_id = issue.get("id", "")
    19→    parts = issue_id.split("::")
    20→    if len(parts) >= 3:
    21→        candidate = parts[-1]
    22→        if "/" not in candidate and "." not in candidate:
    23→            return candidate
    24→    return None
    25→
    26→
    27→def grouping_key(issue: dict, meta: DetectorMeta | None) -> str | None:
    28→    """Compute a deterministic grouping key for a issue."""
    29→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    30→
    31→    if meta is None:
    32→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    33→
    34→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    35→        detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    36→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
    37→        if dimension:
    38→            return f"review::{dimension}"
    39→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    40→
    41→    if meta.needs_judgment and detector in ("structural", "responsibility_cohesion"):
    42→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
    43→        if file_path:
    44→            basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    45→            return f"file::{detector}::{basename}"
    46→
    47→    if meta.needs_judgment:
    48→        subtype = extract_subtype(issue)
    49→        if subtype:
    50→            return f"typed::{detector}::{subtype}"
    51→
    52→    if meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
    53→        return f"auto::{detector}"
    54→
    55→    return f"detector::{detector}"
    56→
    57→
    58→def cluster_name_from_key(key: str) -> str:
    59→    """Convert a grouping key to an ``auto/...`` cluster name."""
    60→    parts = key.split("::")
    61→    if len(parts) == 2:
    62→        prefix_type = parts[0]
    63→        if prefix_type == "review":
    64→            return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}review-{parts[1]}"
    65→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}"
    66→    if len(parts) == 3:
    67→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}"
    68→    return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{key.replace('::', '-')}"
    69→
    70→
    71→def generate_description(
    72→    cluster_name: str,
    73→    members: list[dict],
    74→    meta: DetectorMeta | None,
    75→    subtype: str | None,
    76→) -> str:
    77→    """Generate a human-readable cluster description."""
    78→    _ = cluster_name
    79→    count = len(members)
    80→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
    81→
    82→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    83→        detail = (members[0].get("detail") or {}) if members else {}
    84→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", detector)
    85→        return f"Address {count} {dimension} review issues"
    86→
    87→    if detector == "structural":
    88→        files = {os.path.basename(member.get("file", "")) for member in members}
    89→        if len(files) == 1:
    90→            return f"Review file size: {next(iter(files))}"
    91→        return f"Review {count} large files"
    92→
    93→    display = meta.display if meta else detector
    94→    if subtype:
    95→        label = subtype.replace("_", " ")
    96→        return f"Fix {count} {label} issues"
    97→
    98→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
    99→        return f"Remove {count} {display} issues"
   100→
   101→    return f"Fix {count} {display} issues"
   102→
   103→
   104→def subtype_has_fixer(meta: DetectorMeta, subtype: str | None) -> str | None:
   105→    """Check if a subtype maps to a detector fixer."""
   106→    if not meta.fixers or not subtype:
   107→        return None
   108→    fixer_name = subtype.replace("_", "-")
   109→    if fixer_name in meta.fixers:
   110→        return fixer_name
   111→    for fixer in meta.fixers:
   112→        if subtype in fixer:
   113→            return fixer
   114→    return None
   115→
   116→
   117→def strip_guidance_examples(guidance: str) -> str:
   118→    """Strip subtype examples from guidance text."""
   119→    if " — " in guidance:
   120→        return guidance.split(" — ", 1)[0].strip()
   121→    return guidance
   122→
   123→
   124→_ACTION_TYPE_TEMPLATES: dict[str, str] = {
   125→    "reorganize": "reorganize with desloppify move",
   126→    "refactor": "review and refactor each issue",
   127→    "manual_fix": "review and fix each issue",
   128→}
   129→
   130→
   131→def generate_action(
   132→    meta: DetectorMeta | None,
   133→    subtype: str | None,
   134→) -> str:
   135→    """Generate an action string from detector metadata."""
   136→    if meta is None:
   137→        return "review and fix each issue"
   138→
   139→    if subtype and meta.fixers:
   140→        matched_fixer = subtype_has_fixer(meta, subtype)
   141→        if matched_fixer:
   142→            return f"desloppify autofix {matched_fixer} --dry-run"
   143→    elif meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers and not meta.needs_judgment:
   144→        return f"desloppify autofix {meta.fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   145→
   146→    if meta.tool == "move":
   147→        return "desloppify move"
   148→
   149→    if meta.guidance:
   150→        if subtype:
   151→            return strip_guidance_examples(meta.guidance)
   152→        return meta.guidance
   153→
   154→    return _ACTION_TYPE_TEMPLATES.get(meta.action_type, "review and fix each issue")

1→"""Pruning helpers for auto-generated plan clusters."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→
     6→def prune_stale_clusters(
     7→    plan: dict,
     8→    issues: dict,
     9→    clusters: dict,
    10→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
    11→    now: str,
    12→) -> int:
    13→    """Delete auto-clusters that no longer have matching groups."""
    14→    changes = 0
    15→    for name in list(clusters.keys()):
    16→        cluster = clusters[name]
    17→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
    18→            continue
    19→        cluster_key = cluster.get("cluster_key", "")
    20→        if cluster_key in active_auto_keys:
    21→            continue
    22→        if cluster.get("user_modified"):
    23→            alive = [
    24→                issue_id
    25→                for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
    26→                if issue_id in issues and issues[issue_id].get("status") == "open"
    27→            ]
    28→            if alive:
    29→                if len(alive) != len(cluster.get("issue_ids", [])):
    30→                    cluster["issue_ids"] = alive
    31→                    cluster["updated_at"] = now
    32→                    changes += 1
    33→                continue
    34→        del clusters[name]
    35→        for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
    36→            override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(issue_id)
    37→            if override and override.get("cluster") == name:
    38→                override["cluster"] = None
    39→                override["updated_at"] = now
    40→        if plan.get("active_cluster") == name:
    41→            plan["active_cluster"] = None
    42→        changes += 1
    43→    return changes
    44→
    45→
    46→__all__ = ["prune_stale_clusters"]
    47→

1→"""Ranking and grouping helpers for work queue selection."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→from typing import Any, cast
     7→
     8→from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
     9→from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.health import compute_health_breakdown
    10→from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.impact import get_dimension_for_detector
    11→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import path_scoped_issues
    12→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    13→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import (
    14→    ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY,
    15→    detail_dict,
    16→    is_review_issue,
    17→    is_subjective_issue,
    18→    primary_command_for_issue,
    19→    review_issue_weight,
    20→    scope_matches,
    21→    slugify,
    22→    status_matches,
    23→    supported_fixers_for_item,
    24→    workflow_stage_name,
    25→)
    26→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.ranking_output import (
    27→    group_queue_items,
    28→    item_explain,
    29→    subjective_score_value,
    30→)
    31→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.synthetic import subjective_strict_scores
    32→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.types import WorkQueueItem
    33→from desloppify.engine.planning.helpers import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    34→
    35→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    36→
    37→# Plan-aware sort tiers (item_sort_key)
    38→_TIER_PLANNED = 0   # Items with explicit plan position
    39→_TIER_EXISTING = 1  # Known items, natural ranking
    40→_TIER_NEW = 2       # Newly discovered items
    41→
    42→# Natural ranking groups (_natural_sort_key)
    43→_RANK_INITIAL_REVIEW = -3  # Unassessed subjective dimensions
    44→_RANK_WORKFLOW = -2         # Score checkpoints, create-plan
    45→_RANK_TRIAGE_STAGE = -1     # Epic triage workflow stages
    46→_RANK_CLUSTER = 0           # Auto-clustered issues
    47→_RANK_ISSUE = 1           # Individual issues + assessed subjective
    48→
    49→_TRIAGE_STAGE_ORDER = {
    50→    "observe": 0,
    51→    "reflect": 1,
    52→    "organize": 2,
    53→    "commit": 3,
    54→}
    55→
    56→
    57→def _workflow_stage_index(item: WorkQueueItem) -> int:
    58→    raw_index = item.get("stage_index")
    59→    if raw_index is not None:
    60→        if isinstance(raw_index, int):
    61→            return raw_index
    62→        if isinstance(raw_index, str):
    63→            stripped = raw_index.strip()
    64→            if stripped.lstrip("-").isdigit():
    65→                return int(stripped)
    66→        logger.warning("Invalid workflow stage index %r", raw_index)
    67→    return _TRIAGE_STAGE_ORDER.get(workflow_stage_name(item).lower(), 0)
    68→
    69→
    70→def enrich_with_impact(
    71→    items: list[WorkQueueItem], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]
    72→) -> None:
    73→    """Stamp ``estimated_impact`` on each item based on dimension-level headroom.
    74→
    75→    Impact = ``overall_per_point * headroom`` where headroom = ``100 - score``.
    76→    Items in dimensions with more score headroom sort first.
    77→    """
    78→    if not dimension_scores:
    79→        for item in items:
    80→            item["estimated_impact"] = 0.0
    81→        return
    82→
    83→    breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dimension_scores, score_key="strict")
    84→    entries = breakdown.get("entries", [])
    85→
    86→    # Build lookup: normalized dimension name -> {per_point, headroom}
    87→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    88→    for entry in entries:
    89→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
    90→        if not name:
    91→            continue
    92→        per_point = float(entry.get("overall_per_point", 0.0))
    93→        score = float(entry.get("score", 0.0))
    94→        headroom = 100.0 - score
    95→        dim_impact[name.lower()] = {"per_point": per_point, "headroom": headroom}
    96→
    97→    for item in items:
    98→        impact = _compute_item_impact(item, dim_impact, get_dimension_for_detector)
    99→        item["estimated_impact"] = impact
   100→
   101→
   102→def _compute_item_impact(
   103→    item: WorkQueueItem,
   104→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
   105→    get_dimension_for_detector,
   106→) -> float:
   107→    """Compute impact value for a single queue item."""
   108→    kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   109→
   110→    # Subjective items (synthetic dimensions or subjective issues):
   111→    # look up by detail.dimension_name
   112→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   113→        dim_name = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
   114→        entry = dim_impact.get(dim_name.lower())
   115→        if entry:
   116→            return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
   117→        return 0.0
   118→
   119→    # Mechanical issues: use detector -> dimension mapping
   120→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   121→    if detector:
   122→        dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   123→        if dimension:
   124→            entry = dim_impact.get(dimension.name.lower())
   125→            if entry:
   126→                return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
   127→
   128→    return 0.0
   129→
   130→
   131→def build_issue_items(
   132→    state: StateModel,
   133→    *,
   134→    scan_path: str | None,
   135→    status_filter: str,
   136→    scope: str | None,
   137→    chronic: bool,
   138→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   139→    scoped = path_scoped_issues(state.get("issues", {}), scan_path)
   140→    subjective_scores = subjective_strict_scores(state)
   141→    out: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   142→
   143→    for issue_id, issue in scoped.items():
   144→        if issue.get("suppressed"):
   145→            continue
   146→        if not status_matches(issue.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
   147→            continue
   148→        if chronic and not (
   149→            issue.get("status") == "open" and issue.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2
   150→        ):
   151→            continue
   152→
   153→        # Evidence-only: skip issues below standalone confidence threshold
   154→        detector = issue.get("detector", "")
   155→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   156→        if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
   157→            threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
   158→            issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
   159→            if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
   160→                continue
   161→
   162→        item = cast(WorkQueueItem, dict(issue))
   163→        item["id"] = issue_id
   164→        item["kind"] = "issue"
   165→        item["is_review"] = is_review_issue(item)
   166→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_issue(item)
   167→        item["review_weight"] = (
   168→            review_issue_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
   169→        )
   170→        subjective_score = None
   171→        if item["is_subjective"]:
   172→            detail = detail_dict(issue)
   173→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
   174→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
   175→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(
   176→                dim_key, subjective_scores.get(dim_name.lower(), 100.0)
   177→            )
   178→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
   179→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
   180→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_issue(
   181→            item,
   182→            supported_fixers=supported_fixers,
   183→        )
   184→
   185→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):
   186→            continue
   187→        out.append(item)
   188→
   189→    return out
   190→
   191→
   192→def _natural_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple:
   193→    """Compute natural (non-plan-aware) ranking for queue items."""
   194→    kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   195→
   196→    # Initial-review subjective items: highest priority
   197→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" and item.get("initial_review"):
   198→        return (_RANK_INITIAL_REVIEW, 0, subjective_score_value(item), item.get("id", ""))
   199→
   200→    # Triage stage items: stage order, blocked after unblocked
   201→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   202→        blocked_penalty = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   203→        stage_index = _workflow_stage_index(item)
   204→        return (_RANK_TRIAGE_STAGE, blocked_penalty, stage_index, item.get("id", ""))
   205→
   206→    # Workflow action items (e.g. create-plan)
   207→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   208→        return (_RANK_WORKFLOW, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
   209→
   210→    if kind == "cluster":
   211→        # Clusters sort before individual issues, ordered by action type
   212→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(
   213→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
   214→        )
   215→        return (
   216→            _RANK_CLUSTER,
   217→            action_pri,
   218→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   219→            item.get("id", ""),
   220→        )
   221→
   222→    impact = item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0)
   223→
   224→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   225→        return (
   226→            _RANK_ISSUE,
   227→            -impact,
   228→            subjective_score_value(item),
   229→            0,
   230→            0,
   231→            item.get("id", ""),
   232→        )
   233→
   234→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   235→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   236→    return (
   237→        _RANK_ISSUE,
   238→        -impact,
   239→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   240→        -review_weight,
   241→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   242→        item.get("id", ""),
   243→    )
   244→
   245→
   246→def item_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
   247→    """Unified sort key: plan position first, then natural ranking.
   248→
   249→    When ``_plan_position`` is stamped (by :func:`stamp_plan_sort_keys`),
   250→    planned items sort first in plan order, then existing items by natural
   251→    ranking, then newly-discovered items by natural ranking.
   252→
   253→    When no plan fields are stamped, falls back to pure natural ranking.
   254→    """
   255→    plan_pos = item.get("_plan_position")
   256→
   257→    if plan_pos is not None:
   258→        kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   259→        # Triage stages: even when explicitly planned, maintain the
   260→        # blocked-before-unblocked invariant for correctness.
   261→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   262→            blocked = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   263→            stage_idx = _workflow_stage_index(item)
   264→            return (_TIER_PLANNED, plan_pos, blocked, stage_idx, item.get("id", ""))

   125→    Pipeline:
   126→    1. Gather    — issue items, subjective dimensions, workflow stages
   127→    2. Score     — estimate impact from dimension headroom
   128→    3. Presort   — stamp plan positions, separate skipped items
   129→    4. Lifecycle — filter endgame-only items when objective work remains
   130→    5. Sort      — rank by impact/confidence, apply plan order
   131→    6. Limit     — truncate to count, optionally add explain metadata
   132→    """

   142→    items += _gather_workflow_items(state, plan, status)

   179→def _resolve_inputs(
   180→    opts: QueueBuildOptions, state: StateModel,
   181→) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None, str, float]:
   182→    """Resolve plan, scan_path, status, and subjective threshold from options."""
   183→    ctx = opts.context
   184→    plan = ctx.plan if ctx is not None else opts.plan
   185→
   186→    scan_path: str | None = (
   187→        state.get("scan_path")

   255→def _planned_item_ids(plan: dict) -> set[str]:
   256→    """Collect IDs explicitly tracked by the living plan."""
   257→    tracked_ids: set[str] = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   258→    tracked_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   259→    tracked_ids.update(plan.get("overrides", {}).keys())
   260→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   261→        tracked_ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   262→        for step in cluster.get("action_steps", []):
   263→            if isinstance(step, dict):
   264→                tracked_ids.update(step.get("issue_refs", []))
   265→    subjective_defer_meta = plan.get("subjective_defer_meta", {})
   266→    if isinstance(subjective_defer_meta, dict):
   267→        tracked_ids.update(subjective_defer_meta.get("force_visible_ids", []))
   268→    return tracked_ids
   269→
   270→
   271→def _filter_plan_visibility(
   272→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   273→    plan: dict | None,
   274→    *,
   275→    visibility: str,
   276→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   277→    """Apply plan-based visibility filtering for execution/backlog surfaces."""
   278→    if visibility == QueueVisibility.ALL:
   279→        return items
   280→    if not plan:
   281→        return items
   282→    tracked_ids = _planned_item_ids(plan)
   283→    if not tracked_ids:
   284→        if visibility == QueueVisibility.EXECUTION:
   285→            return [item for item in items if _is_implicit_execution_workflow(item)]
   286→        return items
   287→    if visibility == QueueVisibility.EXECUTION:
   288→        return [
   289→            item for item in items
   290→            if item["id"] in tracked_ids or _is_implicit_execution_workflow(item)
   291→        ]
   292→    if visibility == QueueVisibility.BACKLOG:
   293→        return [
   294→            item for item in items
   295→            if item["id"] not in tracked_ids and not _is_implicit_execution_workflow(item)
   296→        ]
   297→    return items

   299→
   300→def _is_implicit_execution_workflow(item: WorkQueueItem) -> bool:
   301→    """Return True for workflow items that opt into execution visibility."""
   302→    return (
   303→        item.get("kind") == "workflow_action"
   304→        and item.get("execution_visibility") == "always"
   305→    )
   306→
   307→
   308→
   309→def _plan_presort(
   310→    items: list[WorkQueueItem], state: StateModel, plan: dict | None,
   311→) -> tuple[set[str], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   312→    """Enrich plan metadata and stamp sort keys before sorting.
   313→
   314→    Returns ``(new_ids, skipped)`` — skipped items are removed from
   315→    ``items`` in place and returned separately for post-sort re-append.
   316→    """
   317→    if not plan:
   318→        return set(), []
   319→
   320→    new_ids = _new_item_ids(state)
   321→    enrich_plan_metadata(items, plan)
   322→    stamp_plan_sort_keys(items, plan, new_ids)
   323→    remaining, skipped = separate_skipped(items, plan)
   324→    items[:] = remaining
   325→    return new_ids, skipped
   326→
   327→
   328→def _plan_postsort(
   329→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   330→    skipped: list[WorkQueueItem],
   331→    plan: dict | None,
   332→    opts: QueueBuildOptions,
   333→) -> None:
   334→    """Re-append skipped items and stamp positions.
   335→
   336→    Cluster focus filtering is intentionally NOT applied here — it is a
   337→    view-layer concern that callers apply after building the canonical queue.
   338→    This prevents UI focus state from affecting lifecycle decisions (scan
   339→    gating, score display mode, empty-queue fallback).
   340→    """
   341→    if not plan:
   342→        return
   343→
   344→    if opts.include_skipped:
   345→        items.extend(skipped)
   346→    stamp_positions(items, plan)

    91→            colorize_fn=colorize,
    92→            label=f"{command_name} output",
    93→        ):
    94→            return True
    95→        raise CommandError("Failed to write output file")
    96→
    97→    return next_output_mod.emit_non_terminal_output(
    98→        opts.output_format,
    99→        payload,
   100→        items,
   101→        command=command_name,
   102→    )

   174→def _render_terminal_queue_view(
   175→    *,
   176→    queue: dict,

   188→    """Render terminal output for a non-empty queue."""
   189→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})

   193→    )
   194→    plan_start_strict = None

   201→        )
   202→    queue_total = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   203→
   204→    _render_queue_header(queue, opts.explain)
   205→    strict_score = state_mod.score_snapshot(state).strict
   206→    if _show_empty_queue(

   214→    potentials = _merge_potentials_safe(state.get("potentials", {}))
   215→    next_render_mod.render_terminal_items(

   256→def _resolve_queue_items(
   257→    *,
   258→    state: dict,

   265→    ctx = queue_context(

   271→    effective_cluster = _resolve_cluster_focus(

   276→    queue = build_work_queue_fn(

   289→    return ctx, queue, queue.get("items", []), effective_cluster

   292→def _apply_queue_view_transforms(
   293→    *,
   294→    items: list[dict],
   295→    queue: dict,
   296→    opts: NextOptions,
   297→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   298→    effective_cluster: str | None,
   299→    collapse_plan_clusters: bool,
   300→) -> list[dict]:
   301→    visible = items
   302→    if collapse_plan_clusters and effective_cluster and plan_for_queue:
   303→        visible = filter_cluster_focus(visible, plan_for_queue, effective_cluster)
   304→    elif (
   305→        collapse_plan_clusters
   306→        and plan_for_queue
   307→        and not effective_cluster
   308→        and not plan_for_queue.get("active_cluster")
   309→    ):
   310→        visible = collapse_clusters(visible, plan_for_queue)
   311→
   312→    if opts.count:
   313→        visible = visible[: opts.count]
   314→        queue["items"] = visible
   315→        queue["total"] = len(visible)
   316→    return visible

   321→    args: argparse.Namespace,

   336→    lang = resolve_lang_fn(args)
   337→    lang_name = lang.name if lang else None
   338→    narrative = compute_narrative(

   342→    payload = _write_next_payload(

   352→

   356→    _render_terminal_queue_view(

   371→def _build_and_render_queue_view(

   382→    """Build queue payload and render output for a queue surface."""
   383→    opts = NextOptions.from_args(args)
   384→    guardrail_warnings = triage_guardrail_messages(state=state)
   385→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(config)
   386→
   387→    plan = load_plan_fn()
   388→    plan_for_queue = plan
   389→    plan_data = _plan_data_for_view(plan, show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context)
   390→    ctx, queue, items, effective_cluster = _resolve_queue_items(

   398→    items = _apply_queue_view_transforms(
   399→        items=items,

   403→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   404→        collapse_plan_clusters=view.collapse_plan_clusters,
   405→    )
   406→
   407→    if not items:
   408→        _render_empty_queue_view(
   409→            queue=queue,
   410→            items=items,
   411→            state=state,
   412→            plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   413→            plan_data=plan_data,
   414→            ctx=ctx,
   415→            target_strict=target_strict,
   416→            opts=opts,

   418→            write_query_fn=write_query_fn,
   419→            command_name=view.command_name,
   420→            show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context,
   421→        )
   422→        return
   423→
   424→    _render_non_empty_queue(
   425→        args=args,

   427→        items=items,
   428→        queue=queue,
   429→        plan_data=plan_data,

     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from typing import Any
     6→
     7→from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
     8→from desloppify.engine.plan_ops import (

    13→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.types import WorkQueueItem
    14→from desloppify.state_io import StateModel
    15→
    16→
    17→def _cluster_issue_ids(cluster: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    18→    """Return canonical cluster members after plan-load normalization."""
    19→    issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
    20→    if not isinstance(issue_ids, list):
    21→        return []
    22→    return [issue_id for issue_id in issue_ids if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id]
    23→
    24→
    25→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    26→    """Return issue IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    27→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    28→    if not scan_history:
    29→        return set()
    30→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    31→    if not threshold:
    32→        return set()
    33→    return {
    34→        issue_id
    35→        for issue_id, issue in state.get("issues", {}).items()
    36→        if issue.get("first_seen", "") >= threshold
    37→    }
    38→
    39→
    40→def enrich_plan_metadata(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> None:
    41→    """Stamp plan description, note, and cluster info from overrides."""
    42→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    43→
    44→    for item in items:
    45→        issue_id = item["id"]
    46→        description = get_issue_description(plan, issue_id)
    47→        note = get_issue_note(plan, issue_id)
    48→        override = get_issue_override(plan, issue_id)
    49→        if description:
    50→            item["plan_description"] = description
    51→        if note:
    52→            item["plan_note"] = note
    53→        if override.get("cluster"):
    54→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    55→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    56→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    57→                "name": cluster_name,
    58→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    59→                "total_items": len(_cluster_issue_ids(cluster_data)),
    60→                "action_steps": cluster_data.get("action_steps") or [],
    61→            }
    62→
    63→
    64→def stamp_plan_sort_keys(
    65→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
    66→    plan: dict,
    67→    new_ids: set[str],
    68→) -> None:
    69→    """Stamp ``_plan_position`` and ``_is_new`` on each item.
    70→
    71→    These fields are consumed by :func:`item_sort_key` in ``ranking.py``
    72→    to produce the correct final ordering in a single sort pass.
    73→    """
    74→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    75→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    76→    subjective_defer_meta = plan.get("subjective_defer_meta", {})
    77→    if not isinstance(subjective_defer_meta, dict):
    78→        subjective_defer_meta = {}
    79→    normalized_force_visible_ids = sorted({
    80→        str(fid).strip()
    81→        for fid in subjective_defer_meta.get("force_visible_ids", [])
    82→        if str(fid).strip()
    83→    })
    84→    subjective_defer_meta["force_visible_ids"] = normalized_force_visible_ids
    85→    force_visible_ids = set(normalized_force_visible_ids)
    86→
    87→    position_map: dict[str, int] = {}
    88→    for idx, issue_id in enumerate(queue_order):
    89→        if issue_id not in skipped_ids:
    90→            position_map[issue_id] = idx
    91→
    92→    for item in items:
    93→        item_id = item["id"]
    94→        pos = position_map.get(item_id)
    95→        item["_plan_position"] = pos  # None if not in queue_order
    96→        item["_is_new"] = item_id in new_ids
    97→        if item_id in force_visible_ids:
    98→            item["force_visible"] = True
    99→
   100→
   101→def separate_skipped(
   102→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   103→    plan: dict,
   104→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   105→    """Separate skipped items from the main list.
   106→
   107→    Returns ``(non_skipped, skipped)`` so callers can optionally re-append.
   108→    """
   109→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   110→    if not skipped_ids:
   111→        return items, []
   112→    non_skipped: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   113→    skipped: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   114→    for item in items:
   115→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   116→            skipped.append(item)
   117→        else:
   118→            non_skipped.append(item)
   119→    return non_skipped, skipped
   120→
   121→
   122→def filter_cluster_focus(
   123→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   124→    plan: dict,
   125→    cluster: str | None,
   126→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   127→    """Filter to only cluster members when a cluster focus is active."""
   128→    effective_cluster = cluster or plan.get("active_cluster")
   129→    if not effective_cluster:
   130→        return items
   131→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
   132→    cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   133→    cluster_member_ids = set(_cluster_issue_ids(cluster_data))
   134→    if not cluster_member_ids:
   135→        return items
   136→    return [item for item in items if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   137→
   138→
   139→def stamp_positions(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> None:
   140→    """Stamp queue_position and plan_skipped metadata on each item."""
   141→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   142→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
   143→
   144→    for position, item in enumerate(items):
   145→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
   146→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   147→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   148→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   149→            if skip_entry:
   150→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")

1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions`` and ``auto_cluster``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.base.config import DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    13→from desloppify.base.enums import Status
    14→from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
    15→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import issue_in_scan_scope
    16→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    17→from desloppify.engine.planning.helpers import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    18→
    19→# Detectors whose issues are NOT objective mechanical work.
    20→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    21→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    22→})
    23→
    24→
    25→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    26→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    27→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    28→
    29→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective issues?
    30→    objective_count: int  # how many
    31→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    32→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    33→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    34→
    35→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    36→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    37→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    38→            return True  # unconditional
    39→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    40→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    41→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    42→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    43→        return False
    44→
    45→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    46→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    47→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    48→            return False  # never evict unscored
    49→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    50→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    51→        return False
    52→
    53→    @property
    54→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    55→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    56→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    57→
    58→
    59→def _is_evidence_only(issue: dict) -> bool:
    60→    """Return True if the issue is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    61→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    62→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    63→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    64→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    65→        issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    66→        if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
    67→            return True
    68→    return False
    69→
    70→
    71→class _ScanPathFromStatePolicy:
    72→    """Sentinel type: resolve scan_path from state."""
    73→
    74→
    75→_SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY = _ScanPathFromStatePolicy()
    76→ScanPathPolicyOption = str | None | _ScanPathFromStatePolicy
    77→
    78→
    79→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    80→    state: StateModel,
    81→    *,
    82→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    83→    scan_path: ScanPathPolicyOption = _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY,
    84→    plan: dict | None = None,
    85→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    86→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    87→
    88→    *scan_path* defaults to ``state["scan_path"]`` so callers don't need to
    89→    thread it manually.  Pass an explicit ``str`` to override, or ``None``
    90→    to disable scope filtering.  When *plan* is set, issues whose IDs
    91→    appear in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    92→
    93→    Imports policy helpers from ``stale_policy`` so this module remains
    94→    side-effect free and cycle-safe.
    95→    """
    96→    from desloppify.engine._plan.policy.stale import (
    97→        current_stale_ids,
    98→        current_under_target_ids,
    99→        current_unscored_ids,
   100→    )
   101→
   102→    resolved_scan_path: str | None = (
   103→        state.get("scan_path")
   104→        if isinstance(scan_path, _ScanPathFromStatePolicy)
   105→        else scan_path
   106→    )
   107→
   108→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   109→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   110→
   111→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective issues.
   112→    # Evidence-only issues (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   113→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   114→    # Issues outside scan_path and plan-skipped issues are also excluded
   115→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   116→    objective_count = sum(
   117→        1
   118→        for issue_id, issue in issues.items()
   119→        if issue.get("status") == Status.OPEN
   120→        and issue.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   121→        and not issue.get("suppressed")
   122→        and not _is_evidence_only(issue)
   123→        and issue_in_scan_scope(str(issue.get("file", "")), resolved_scan_path)
   124→        and issue_id not in skipped_ids
   125→    )
   126→
   127→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   128→    stale = current_stale_ids(state)
   129→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   130→
   131→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   132→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   133→        objective_count=objective_count,
   134→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   135→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   136→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   137→    )
   138→
   139→
   140→__all__ = [
   141→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   142→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   143→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   144→]

    20→    raw_target = default
    21→    if isinstance(config, dict):

    23→    try:

    53→def review_issue_weight(item: WorkQueueItem | dict[str, Any]) -> float:
    54→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""

    67→def scope_matches(item: WorkQueueItem | dict[str, Any], scope: str | None) -> bool:
    68→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    69→    if not scope:
    70→        return True
    71→
    72→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    73→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    74→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    75→    summary = item.get("summary", "")

    77→    kind = item.get("kind", "")

    79→    if "*" in scope:
    80→        return any(

    82→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)

    84→
    85→    if "::" in scope:

    97→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
